description: Interface defining write operations for savings account management in the Fineract platform, including activation, transactions, charges, transfers, and account status updates.

classes.name: SavingsAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for savings account write operations, including activation, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, charges, and account status management.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a savings account given its ID and a command object.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits funds into a savings account.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Withdraws funds from a savings account.

methods.name: applyAnnualFee
methods.description: Applies an annual fee to a savings account charge.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for a savings account.

methods.name: reverseTransaction
methods.description: Reverses a specific transaction on a savings account.

methods.name: undoTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a transaction on a savings account.

methods.name: adjustSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts a savings account transaction.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes a savings account.

methods.name: initiateSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer of savings to another account.

methods.name: withdrawSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Completes a savings transfer withdrawal.

methods.name: rejectSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Rejects a savings transfer.

methods.name: acceptSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Accepts a savings transfer.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to a savings account.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates a savings account charge.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge from a savings account.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a specific charge on a savings account.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Pays a charge on a savings account.

methods.name: inactivateCharge
methods.description: Inactivates a charge on a savings account.

methods.name: assignFieldOfficer
methods.description: Assigns a field officer to a savings account.

methods.name: unassignFieldOfficer
methods.description: Removes the field officer assignment.

methods.name: applyChargeDue
methods.description: Applies due charges to a savings account.

methods.name: processPostActiveActions
methods.description: Processes actions after account activation.

methods.name: modifyWithHoldTax
methods.description: Modifies withholding tax on a savings account.

methods.name: setSubStatusInactive
methods.description: Sets the account sub-status to inactive.

methods.name: setSubStatusDormant
methods.description: Sets the account sub-status to dormant.

methods.name: escheat
methods.description: Escheats a savings account.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts interest to a savings account.

methods.name: blockAccount
methods.description: Blocks a savings account.

methods.name: unblockAccount
methods.description: Unblocks a savings account.

methods.name: holdAmount
methods.description: Holds an amount in a savings account.

methods.name: blockCredits
methods.description: Blocks credits to a savings account.

methods.name: unblockCredits
methods.description: Unblocks credits.

methods.name: blockDebits
methods.description: Blocks debits from a savings account.

methods.name: unblockDebits
methods.description: Unblocks debits.

methods.name: releaseAmount
methods.description: Releases a held amount.

methods.name: gsimActivate
methods.description: Activates a G-SIM.

methods.name: gsimDeposit
methods.description: Deposits into a G-SIM.

methods.name: bulkGSIMClose
methods.description: Closes multiple G-SIMs.
